Algorithmic & Theoretical Foundations
05 / 10

Graph-Theoretic Dynamic Programming Solver

Single-routing call efficiency replaces naive multiple routing requests with geometric projection and linear-time DAG optimization.

📐
1. Station Polyline Projection
Projects geocoded fuel plazas onto the route polyline using local flat-plane Euclidean coordinates:

t = max(0, min(1, (S-A)·(B-A)/||B-A||²))

Stations exceeding 5.0 miles corridor tolerance are discarded; candidates are indexed by cumulative route mile marker.
5-Mile Corridor Pruning
🕸️
2. Forward-Only Reachability DAG
Candidate nodes bounded by Origin (0.0 mi) and Destination (Total mi) form an ordered topological sequence:

N0 < N1 < N2 < ... < Nk

Directed edges are added only if mile(u) < mile(v) and distance ≤ 500 miles. Topological monotonicity guarantees an acyclic graph.
Range Limit ≤ 500 Miles
⚡
3. Linear-Time DP Solver
Solves the global cost-minimization problem in O(V + E) time:

cost[v] = min(cost[v], cost[u] + g × price[u])

If cost[Destination] = ∞, the platform immediately raises HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity, preventing vehicle fuel exhaustion.
< 1ms Solver Complexity
Exact 1 Directions API Call per Trip • Geometric In-Memory Interpolation
Deterministic Optimization Guarantees

09 / 10

Cloud Architecture & Zero-Key Readiness

Serverless container deployment on AWS Lambda with automated GitHub Actions CI and multi-tier sub-second caching.

🚀
Serverless AWS Lambda
Packaged as an automated container image deployed on Amazon ECR + AWS Lambda with AWS Lambda Web Adapter (LWA):

• Public HTTPS Function URL with zero API Gateway overhead.
• Auto-scales from 0 to thousands of concurrent requests.
• Lean Gunicorn WSGI runtime optimized for 1024MB memory.
One-Click deploy_lambda.sh
⚡
Multi-Tier Caching Pipeline
To guarantee sub-second responses and prevent external rate limits:

• Client LRU Session Cache: Instant 0ms response in browser for repeat queries.
• SHA-256 Memory Cache: In-memory route caching with X-Cache: HIT responses in 0.06s.
• Decoupled Async TTS: Audio synthesizes on-demand without blocking route calculations.
0.06s Cached Latency
🔑
Zero-Key First Architecture
Engineered to operate 100% out of the box with zero paid API keys:

• Routing: Free OSRM road network.
• Geocoding: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim.
• Weather: Open-Meteo checkpoint models.
• Enterprise Switch: Seamlessly enables Amazon Location & Sarvam AI via .env flags.
Zero Setup Friction
69 Automated Tests Passing • 100% CI Coverage
